mapper.select: select config_id as configId, circuit_breaker_failure_threshold as circuitBreakerFailureThreshold, circuit_breaker_cooldown_minutes as circuitBreakerCooldownMinutes, output_format as outputFormat, output_compression as outputCompression, model_pricings as modelPricings, resolution_multipliers as resolutionMultipliers, remark from ai_image_global_config where config_id = 1 limit 1
mapper.insert: insert into ai_image_global_config( config_id, circuit_breaker_failure_threshold, circuit_breaker_cooldown_minutes, output_format, output_compression, model_pricings, resolution_multipliers, remark, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time ) values ( #{configId}, #{circuitBreakerFailureThreshold}, #{circuitBreakerCooldownMinutes}, #{outputFormat}, #{outputCompression}, #{modelPricings}, #{resolutionMultipliers}, #{remark}, #{createBy}, sysdate(), #{updateBy}, sysdate() )
mapper.update: update ai_image_global_config set circuit_breaker_failure_threshold = #{circuitBreakerFailureThreshold}, circuit_breaker_cooldown_minutes = #{circuitBreakerCooldownMinutes}, output_format = #{outputFormat}, output_compression = #{outputCompression}, model_pricings = #{modelPricings}, resolution_multipliers = #{resolutionMultipliers}, remark = #{remark}, update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = sysdate() where config_id = #{configId}
mapper.select: select provider_code as providerCode, provider_name as providerName, adapter_type as adapterType, response_mode as responseMode, supports_batch as supportsBatch, base_url as baseUrl, api_key as apiKey, enabled, sort_order as sortOrder, remark from ai_image_provider order by sort_order asc, provider_code asc
select provider_code as providerCode, model, provider_model as providerModel, enabled from ai_image_provider_model order by provider_code asc, model asc

select model, enabled, primary_provider_code as primaryProviderCode, backup_provider_code as backupProviderCode, fallback_enabled as fallbackEnabled, sort_order as sortOrder, remark from ai_image_model_route order by sort_order asc, model asc
